Stricter matching: no more sequels' or other consoles' manuals, no promotional flyers. Manuals picked before that don't match are set aside (kept in the backup folder) and looked up again. Games with no manual anywhere say "no manual found online".
No more thumbnail "pages", huge scans made a sensible size, and digital manuals and box wraps are no longer cut in half.
